title: Incorrect label_mask tensor creation in NumpyPaddedFSLDataset
root_cause: torch.ones_like(input_ids) creates int64 mask, padded with pad_token_id instead of bool+False
invariant: label_mask must be bool dtype with False padding

expected_output.buggy: BUG DETECTED: label_mask uses int64 dtype
expected_output.fixed: CLEAN: label_mask uses bool dtype with False padding
